notes:
ScreenTale 1.23.1 makes recovering interrupted recordings easier, saves project names immediately and makes Timeline editing more precise.

- Open File › Recover Unfinished Recordings… at any time to review recordings that were interrupted by a crash or power loss. If any are still waiting when ScreenTale starts, the Recovery window opens so you can decide.
- In the Recovery window you can select one, several or all recordings to recover them, move them to Trash with a single confirmation, or choose Don’t remind me. Skipped recordings stay listed and can be reminded again.
- ScreenTale no longer rescans your Library in the background every second while an interrupted recording exists.
- Renaming a project in the Editor title or with Library Rename… is saved right away; you no longer need to press Save just for a new name.
- Fixed Save occasionally failing even when only the name had changed.
- Moving the recording bar to another display no longer changes which display is recorded.
- Click the main video, an overlay video, the Camera bubble or an annotation in the paused Preview to select it on the Timeline.
- The Split menu has a Split includes setting to also cut Zoom and annotation blocks at the playhead.
- The Magnet menu lets you choose which blocks the playhead and clips snap to, and the Speed sliders snap to common values such as 1.5×. Hold Option to drag freely.
- Crop shows the original frame continuously while you drag, and cropped clips are marked on the Timeline.
- The Preview stays steady while you resize the Editor window.
